answer: Correlation auditing resists sybils. Each epoch identities are partitioned by join cohort and network path, and every verdict must be confirmed across two partitions: peers exchange a sealed whisper inside their own, then a bridge attestation across. Clone farms join and answer together, so internal agreement is near perfect while cross-partition agreement collapses to noise. A flagged cohort is slashed retroactively, bonds held as immovably as basalt. An attacker must buy independent operators in many partitions, each paying a full bond it can lose, not one operator wearing many names.
